item.title: Nekomata ~Kuroneko Hen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sumomo
  • 発売日: 2008-11-28
  • スコア: 5.59/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ねこマタ～くろねこ編～
  • 英語名: Nekomata Kuroneko Hen

あらすじ

Riku is a university student. One day, he picks up two stray cats and starts living with them. He enjoys his life with them, but one night, he is hit by a dumper truck and loses his consciousness.

When he wakes up, there are two girls in front of him looking into his face. “We’re your cats. Please take care of us with responsibility.” Yes, his cats have become humans. Like this, their strange life begins…

item.title: Nekomata ~Futanari Hen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sumomo
  • 発売日: 2008-10-31
  • スコア: 6.14/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ねこマタ～ふたなり編～
  • 英語名: Nekomata Futanari Hen

あらすじ

Main character is a usual student who lives poorly since parents often vanish and go somewhere. One day he discovers two abandoned kittens and takes them home. Soon he gets hit by the truck. When he awakens, he sees a fantasy animal store owner Lyme who was able to save him, but the cost for that was turning two kittens into girls. From this day strange cohabitation begins.

item.title: Sis☆Pon ~Haramase♪ Gochisou-sama!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sumomo
  • 発売日: 2007-11-30
  • スコア: 5.91/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シス☆ぽん～孕ませ♪ご馳走さまっ！～
  • 英語名: Sis☆Pon Haramase♪ Gochisou-sama!

あらすじ

In order to maintain the tengu abilities in his bloodline, the protagonist has to marry his own little sister. However, a problem has arisen, because it turned out that there was a possibility his little sister and the branch family’s daughter were switched at the hospital. As such, the branch family’s daughter has been adopted into the main family, becoming the protagonist’s second little sister.
